subject.title: fix(openclaw): harden bridge identity and smoke locking

question: Does the owned-lock plus canonical compatibility-marker design safely interoperate with smoke runs and lock directories created by v0.1.11 and current main?
rationale: The patch changes a persistent cross-process locking protocol, and focused unit tests cannot fully establish correctness while old and new processes share an output directory.

options.title: Require mixed-version proof
options.body: Demonstrate old and new implementations sharing one output directory through acquisition, renewal, stale release, recovery, and successor ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept focused-test coverage
options.body: Merge after code review while explicitly accepting that rolling-upgrade interoperability has not been demonstrated in a real multi-process setup.

recommendation.title: Require mixed-version proof
recommendation.body: Demonstrate old and new implementations sharing one output directory through acquisition, renewal, stale release, recovery, and successor ownership before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the lock protocol redesign and is the strongest evidence-backed owner available for the compatibility decision.
